name: @zuojinxin/dsh-annotation
description: DSH selection-annotation plugin for chat messages and workspace file previews: select text, annotate (optional), press Enter to send the annotation block with your message — the model replies to each annotation by number, with hoverable chips in the reply.

scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('lib', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.check: npm run build && node --check lib/index.js && node --check client.js && npm test
